sloka: ततः स बाणासनचित्रकार्मुकः शरप्रवर्षो युधि राक्षसाम्बुदः ।शरान् मुमोचाशु हरीश्वराचले वलाहको वृष्टिमिवाचलोत्तमे ।। ५.४७.१८।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa bāṇāsanacitrakārmukaḥ śarapravarṣo yudhi rākṣasāmbudaḥ ।śarān mumocāśu harīśvarācale valāhako vṛṣṭimivācalottame ।। 5.47.18।।।।

translations.english: Aksha, with his wonderful quiver and bow, began to rain rapidly a shower of arrows in the battle, on the mountainlike monkeylord just as a cloud rains on a mountain.
